name: @thinkrail/pi-ask-user-question
description: A pi extension adding an `ask_user_question` tool: the agent asks structured multiple-choice questions instead of guessing, answered in a terminal questionnaire, in an RPC host's dialogs, or in a host's own UI such as ThinkRail, the agentic IDE built on p
